title: System-level lengths and capacities restated on every string of a multi-string system (6 systems, 2026-08-11) — and the one apparent aggregate-vs-segment double count is REFUTED
summary: Kazakhstan's gas network is mostly multi-string trunk systems carried as one GEM row per string, and in at least six of them the row set repeats ONE system-level figure on every string instead of each string's own value: Central Asia-Center 60.20 bcm/y on P2291/P5770/P5771 (P2292 reads 5.00 - the control that proves it), BTBA 1,585.00 km on P0739/P5810, Bukhara-Ural 21.00 bcm/y on P2289/P5695 (P5695's 2,382.00 km is KMG AR2019/2020's whole-system length), Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau 4.54 bcm/y on all four rows, Makat-North Caucasus, and the byte-identical CS14-Aktobe pair P5927/P5928. Summing the rows double- or triple-counts real pipe and throughput. Two traps: Kazakhstan has NO public line-wise gas register, so per-string figures may not be resolvable at all (several rows will legitimately end as ResearcherNotes rather than value changes); and KMG's AR2019/AR2020 vs AR2021 disagree materially on the same systems, so a row matching AR2020 is DATED, not corroborated - two vintages of one publisher are ONE origin. SEPARATELY, AND IMPORTANT: cluster A (Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau) looked like a clean ~149 km aggregate-vs-segment DOUBLE COUNT - P3948's 137.85 km trace is the exact concatenation of P5777's 58.22 + P5783's 79.63, and the sheet agreed to 0.20 km (17.80 + 60.70 + 70.80 = 149.30 vs P3948's 149.10). That reading is now REFUTED and the recommendation to FOLD P3948 is WITHDRAWN. Two independent official Russian-language sources name P3948 as its own physical line by name, diameter AND length: Intergas Central Asia's own environmental-permit filing (ecoportal.kz/Public/PubHearings/LoadFile/182922, a PDF - url_verifier's substring check is a documented false negative there, read it with pdftotext -layout) states 'Магистральный газопровод высокого давления Ду 720 мм «Жанаозен - Жетыбай - Актау» протяженностью 149,1 км', and the Mangistau regional development plan item 116 (adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2100000784#z12) enumerates 'Жанаозен – Жетыбай – Актау' Ду 720 мм, 'КазГПЗ-КС «Жанаозен»' Ду 720 мм and 'Жанаозен – Жетыбай – Актау' Ду 529/530 мм as one joint capital-repair programme. So GEM's rows map 1:1 onto real lines - P3948 = the 720 mm trunk (149.1 km), P5776 = the KazGPZ-KS Zhanaozen feeder (720 mm, 17.8 km), P5777 + P5783 = the 529/530 mm trunk split at Zhetybay (131.50 km), P5789 = the fourth thread under construction. The 0.20 km near-identity is a coincidence of two parallel trunks plus a feeder, and the geometric identity is what you get if the segment routes were digitized by CUTTING the parent's trace - the same shared-right-of-way convention six other Kazakh systems follow. FOUR consequences: (1) do not fold P3948, and do not shorten it; (2) the earlier '~280 km of missing parallel pipe' reading is withdrawn too, though '3-х ниток' is grammatically ambiguous - it may enumerate the three named lines, in which case GEM's SegmentName numerals I/II/III/III are CORRECT (the two rows numbered III are the two stretches of the third line, so the earlier 'mislabelled numerals' claim is withdrawn), or it may mean three threads of the 720 mm line alone, in which case pipe is missing - do NOT decide it on the numerals; (3) a NEW open spec question, why the 529/530 trunk measures 131.50 km against the 720 mm trunk's 149.10 km for nominally the same endpoints; (4) 529 mm is not a typo - ecoportal's segment table puts 530 mm on Zhanaozen-Zhetybay and 529 mm on Zhetybay-Aktau, so the 529-vs-530 'transcription' reading is withdrawn. Still open on the capacity side: 4.54 bcm/y belongs on PipelineNetworkGrouping, and the 3.60 bcm/y that kt.kz 2008 and Neft i Gaz 2019 give is a separate question (Intergas dates the pre-repair figure at 2.68; one shard reads 3.60 as the distinct Zhetybay-Kuryk branch P5784). THE METHOD RULE, which cluster A is the cautionary tale for: in Kazakhstan gas, identical drawn geometry is NOT evidence of duplication - six systems assign one corridor geojson to every string, segment traces cut from a parent produce the union identity for free, and only SOURCING decides duplication here. P5789's byte-identical copy of P3948's trace is legitimate for the same reason (what it does not confer is a length or an accuracy grade of its own).

title: GulfPub: the >10% status-conflict gate is crossed on paper and empty in fact (4 conflicts, 2 rows, 0 real)
summary: The GulfPub run reports 4 status conflicts against 27 overlaps (14.8%, over the 10% escalation gate), but they collapse to TWO GEM rows and both are the segment-vs-network artifact, not a disagreement: P7819 (Karachaganak-Uralsk thread II, GEM proposed) and P6712 (Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent III capacity expansion, GEM proposed) are in-development ADDITIONS to corridors GulfPub maps as operating lines. GulfPub is describing the corridor; GEM is tracking the increment. Do not flip either status on this evidence. Additions are also below the 30-row gate (5: 1 DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE Kairan-Zapadno Kashagan 55.6 km, 4 NEAR_MISS - Zapadno Kashagan-Atyrau, and a Kostanay/Rudniy/Kachar cluster in the north worth one adjudication pass).

title: OSM: 110 additions crosses the gate, but 55 of them are fragments of rows GEM already has - and the best_guess PID is arithmetic, not geography
summary: The OSM run returns 2 overlaps against 112 traces and 110 additions, far over the 30-addition gate, with 55 DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE (also over the 5-cluster gate). Read the health line first: 3.6% of traces named, 100% with geometry, 95.1% of GEM rows routed, escalations EMPTY - no MATCH_QUALITY warning. The cause is granularity plus an unnamed extract: 55 traces are explicitly FRAGMENT_OF_EXISTING (6,084 km of trace inside GEM routes GEM already draws, 11 of them over 100 km), and the 55 discovery candidates are mostly short stubs (median 0.9 km, only 5 at or over 50 km). Do NOT add a geoarea_weight override - geoarea is 0% scored because this extract carries no admin tags, not because the weights are wrong. Critical triage caveat: the 'nearest GEM row' offered on an unnamed trace whose guessed row has no drawn route was computed on LENGTH ALONE - 18 traces spread from lon 51 to lon 78 all came back nearest to routeless P5776 (17.8 km), some 1,500 km from its corridor. reconcile.py was fixed 2026-08-11 to say so in the note; the rebuilt workbook (…_20260811_1043_ET_…reconciliation-osm.xlsx) carries the honest wording. Worth a look: the two 100+ km unmatched traces near Bukhara-Ural (198.7 km) and Karachaganak-Uralsk (146.2 km).

title: P7819 is a three-way route-sync violation (RouteType vs RouteAccuracy vs the routes repo)
summary: P7819 (Karachaganak-Uralsk thread II) carries RouteAccuracy = 'very low (straight line/schematic)' and RouteType = 'Not mapped (but could be...)' while real geometry exists for it in GOIT-GGIT-pipeline-routes. That is the same defect Egypt's P7338 has: a merged route ALWAYS implies RouteType = 'Mapped route (at any accuracy)' - 'at any accuracy' is literal. The repair is mechanical (apply_route_candidates.py --backfill-route-type) but it writes the live sheet, so it needs explicit per-batch authorization; it is NOT part of this staged packet.

title: Half of Kazakhstan's ref cells were checked by a broken verifier before 2026-08-11 (our defect, fixed)
summary: url_verifier.verify_url reported a bare 'request failed: SSLError' for hosts serving an incomplete TLS certificate chain, which reads as a dead link. adilet.zan.kz - the Kazakh legal-acts portal that carries about half this country's refs - is exactly such a host. The defect hit 51 of 105 ref cells with ZERO real 404s (45 SSLError + 5 ConnectionError + 1 ReadTimeout); the operating leg went 55 to 63 all-live once fixed, and the annual leg's DEAD_LINK count fell 41 to 37 on a rebuild. Two carry-forward rules for anyone working these refs: (1) an adilet.zan.kz verdict stamped insecure_tls: True means the page IS LIVE - never drop the ref; (2) adilet's #z250 anchors land in Appendices 5-7, which are графические схемы (MAPS), so a full-text search miss is not evidence the ref fails - about 51 refs here must be judged against graphics. Also note the residual DEAD_LINK class is documented as 'dead / value-missing': most entries are HTTP 200 with contains_value false, not a dead page. Confirmed genuine deaths: gurk.kz (404), kazazot.kz (404).
